title: Public Algorithm Documentation Publication Record
description: A record confirming that a public-body algorithm's decision logic has been published proactively, including the publication date and where it can be found.
evidence_description: A record confirming an algorithm's decision logic was published to the public register, including the publication date, the version of the algorithm documented, and a link to where it is accessible.
collection_method: Logged by the register's maintainer at the time of publication or update.
retention_period: For the lifetime of the algorithm, plus a minimum of 5 years.
artifact_format: Structured export (CSV/JSON) of publication records, plus the published documentation itself.
